issue.title: test_default_config_matches_public_schema flakes under the full parallel lane across ~10 workspaces since 2026-08-07, including on a clean tree

task_type_fields.evidence:
Promoted by `just selection-health --fail-on-new-flake` as a reproducible flake over the durable host record store. This is the broadest evidence set of the six nodes the gate currently promotes: 12 gate-eligible (<=5-failure) full-run records spanning 2026-08-07 through 2026-08-24 across roughly ten independent workspaces.

- 20260807T144605Z-7ca08ae0ef47 (4 failures)
- 20260818T004754Z-0b8bac8376a5 (1 failure)
- 20260820T134512Z-82e68005f079 (3 failures)
- 20260824T181936Z-54ede7fa5d07 (4) / 182506Z-cbea4f23b255 (3) / 182958Z-f72ff9f38564 (5)
- 20260824T183737Z-cbea4f23b255 (3) / 185523Z-d88994bd816d (4) / 190646Z-d88994bd816d (4)
- 20260824T190945Z-54ede7fa5d07 (3)
- 20260824T195813Z-ad9ed74aff24 (CLEAN tree, 2 failures)
- 20260824T200113Z-04299c29e7d7 (1 failure)

The clean-tree record on 2026-08-24 is the decisive one: it rules out uncommitted edits to `src/sase/default_config.yml` or the public schema as the whole story, so there is a real ordering or process-global-state race underneath. The 2026-08-24 cluster (9 records in ~2 hours) suggests something landed that day made it much easier to hit.

PASSES SERIALLY on master f56cf4333: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:randomly tests/test_config_schema.py::test_default_config_matches_public_schema` gives `passed` in 0.10s. It also passed in the full 37073-node check-full run driven from this workspace (monitor hxz0b4zxzgcw).

Worth checking against sase-j7 ("Fix the sase-ct flake class at its root - process-global state leaking between tests"), and against the config-cache isolation work already retired in tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt under sase-nv (3a22ff04f, "fix(config): isolate config cache from test-owned CONFIG_DIR") -- this node may be the same leak class surfacing at a different assertion.

Reported by epic sase-tt's land agent (sase-tt.land) while triaging the flake gate before closing sase-tt. Not caused by that epic: the evidence starts 18 days before it existed.
